name: DVC Open Source Data Version Control
free_limit: Apache-2.0 local CLI for dataset/model versioning, reproducible pipelines and ML experiment tracking using Git; no per-seat software license or vendor-imposed data-version quota.
watch_out: DVC CLI is free software, not free hosted object storage or compute. Optional AWS S3, GCS, Azure, remote servers and Git hosting may charge for storage, requests, egress or compute; DVC Studio is a separate offering.
